plot: Over the course of a single day, the fractured lives of emotionally damaged strangers begin colliding through coincidence, regret, and buried pain ~ each one still trying to survive the damage inherited from people who are now dying, absent, or barely present. A sprawling, operatic film about loneliness, forgiveness, and the desperate human need to connect before time runs out.
